verdict.rationale: Railway documents user-specified conditions that automatically fire Slack, Discord, or email notifications, and its agent can automatically investigate failed deployments. Both are event-triggered behaviors, but the actions are limited to alerts and a built-in agent response, not a general rule engine for arbitrary user-defined actions. Missing for 10: user-configurable rules that trigger arbitrary actions (e.g., redeploy, scale, run jobs), documentation of rule definition/configuration depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Slack, Discord, or emails the moment conditions you specify are met.
When a deployment fails, the agent can automatically investigate.
